metadata.name: Gridiron
metadata.description:
[h1]Gridiron: American football for Isaac[/h1] Suit up! Football gear with its own mechanics: no reskins, no stat-only items.
[h2]What's inside[/h2] [list] [*][b]16 items[/b]: Football Helmet (tackles + facemask), Shoulder Pads, Team Jersey, Football Cleats, Eye Black, Receiver Gloves, Mouthguard, Padded Pants, Chin Strap, Foam Finger, Super Bowl Ring, Gatorade Bucket, Kicking Tee, Pigskin, Playbook, Coach's Whistle and more [*][b]3 familiars[/b]: Cheerleader, Water Boy, Tackling Dummy [*][b]2 trinkets, a card and a pill[/b]: Referee Flag, Concussion Protocol, Coin Toss, Timeout! [*][b]Wear 3+ pieces to get Suited Up[/b]: bonus damage, faster tackles, gold glow [*][b]Worn costumes[/b]: helmet with facemask, jersey over pads, pants and cleats, eye black [*][b]A new boss[/b]: The Linebacker, plus Mascot and Referee enemies [*][b]A new character[/b]: The Quarterback and Tainted Quarterback [*][b]3 challenges[/b]: Fourth and Long, Two-Minute Drill, Ground Game [*][b]Settings[/b] in the Dead Sea Scrolls menu (press C), External Item Descriptions support, save & continue support [/list]
Debug console: [b]gridiron give[/b] spawns all the gear, [b]gridiron boss[/b] summons the Linebacker.
Requires Repentance+. REPENTOGON is not required. Source and bug reports: github.com/bulmaspanties/tboifbm
